name: Maselukae
bio:
Immerse yourself in the artistic ambiance of Maselukae, a renowned tattoo studio nestled at Avda Fernandez Balsera 30, where masterful skin artistry comes to life. Specializing in the evocative shades of black & gray, the vibrant strokes of neotraditional, and the breathtaking detail of realism, Maselukae offers a transformative journey for both the tattoo enthusiast and the aspiring artist seeking to hone their craft in the attached academy, complemented by state-of-the-art tattoo removal services for when you seek a fresh canvas.
